name: Blackmaw Pouches
summary: Ekkal asks you to recover personal belongings from Blackmaw Hold for the families of those inside. The pouches will give their families something to remember them by.

sections.title: A Keepsake for Families
sections.body: At the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara, Ekkal asks you to bring back Blackmaw Pouches from Blackmaw Hold. Ekkal says those within the hold are beyond saving, and hopes their belongings can give their families something to remember them by.

faq.q: Who is asking for the pouches?
faq.answer: Ekkal asks you to recover Blackmaw Pouches for the families of those inside Blackmaw Hold.

faq.q: Where do I bring the pouches?
faq.answer: Bring the Blackmaw Pouches to Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
The pouches are inside Blackmaw Hold.

faq.q: Why does Ekkal want the belongings?
faq.answer: Ekkal hopes the belongings will give the families something to remember their loved ones by.
Ekkal calls those inside Blackmaw Hold his brothers and sisters, and says they are irreparably corrupted.
